page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz. The instance features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 8 vCPUs. It is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This hardware profile does not include local storage or dedicated GPU resources, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average performance across most standard workloads, with some limitations in raw compute and memory throughput. The instance achieves average scores in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, as well as Passmark CPU and memory evaluations. However, stress-ng single-core performance registers in the bottom 10%, and multi-core performance falls in the bottom 25%. Large-block memory bandwidth tests also place in the bottom 25%, indicating potential bottlenecks for memory-intensive operations. Conversely, cached small-block memory reads and single-threaded compression tasks perform within the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6a.2xlarge offers a dedicated compute resource allocation at a lower memory-to-CPU ratio, making it suitable for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs reduces overhead for workloads that rely on external databases or network-based storage. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and general-purpose application hosting that aligns with its average performance profile.
